turns.q: How do I use it properly the very first time?
turns.replyTail:
Using your new waterproof jewelry for the first time is super easy! Here are a few simple tips to keep it shining:

Apply first, wear last: Put on your perfumes, lotions, and cosmetics before sliding on your jewelry.
Wear it anywhere: Our waterproof pieces are safe for the shower, pool, and workouts.
Clean gently: Wipe your piece with a soft cloth after wearing to remove any oils.
Store safely: Keep it in your reusable pouch when you are not wearing it 🙂
